mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, reader_idx, participation_field, participation_type, user_name, user_date, user_phone, protector_phone, user_email, postcode, address_base, address_detailed, approval_status, delete_yn, add_id, add_date FROM READER_CONTEST WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM READER_CONTEST WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND delete_yn = 'N'
AND ${search_type} LIKE '%'||#{search_text}||'%'

SELECT homepage_id, reader_idx, participation_field, participation_type, user_name, user_date, user_phone, protector_phone, user_email, postcode, address_base, address_detailed, approval_status, delete_yn, add_id, add_date FROM READER_CONTEST WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND reader_idx = #{reader_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO READER_CONTEST ( homepage_id, reader_idx, participation_field, participation_type, user_name, user_date, user_phone, protector_phone, user_email, postcode, address_base, address_detailed, approval_status, delete_yn, add_id, add_date ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(reader_idx), 0)+1 FROM READER_CONTEST), #{participation_field}, #{participation_type}, #{user_name}, #{user_date}, #{user_phone}, #{protector_phone}, #{user_email}, #{postcode}, #{address_base}, #{address_detailed}, #{approval_status}, #{delete_yn}, #{add_id}, SYSDATE )
